{{Youmay|the Trandoshan|the Imperial [[Jeffren Brek]]}}
'''Brek''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of [[Veneb Drassk's clan]]. He was present during the [[Skirmish on Taris|confrontation]] between [[Veneb Drassk]] and [[Qyzen Fess]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. After Drassk's death, Brek studied the true hunter's path under Fess, and became one of Fess's primary [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] in the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] after the disappearance of the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
